title: quick-fix italian bryndza cheese frittata
description: a paleo-friendly, quick-fix italian dish featuring bryndza cheese, jammy and crumbly. perfect for a weeknight snack or lunch.
instructions: crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork.
add the crumbled bryndza cheese, chopped parsley, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir to combine.
heat the olive oil in a 9-inch skillet over medium heat.
add the grated parmesan cheese and cook for 1-2 minutes, until starting to brown.
pour in the egg mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to set.
use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the frittata towards the center, allowing the uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
continue cooking and folding the frittata for 2-3 minutes, until almost set.
use the spatula to carefully transfer the frittata to a plate and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh basil.
if serving as a snack or appetizer, consider cutting the frittata into small squares or nigiri-shaping it for a fun and unique presentation.
